response.sql: WITH telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.avg_pulse, oa.overall_avg FROM telescope_avgs ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val oa WHERE ta.avg_pulse > oa.overall_avg), second_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg FROM above_overall), final_telescopes AS (SELECT ao.avg_pulse, ao.overall_avg, sa.second_avg FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN second_avg_val sa WHERE ao.avg_pulse > sa.second_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse, AVG(avg_pulse - overall_avg) as avg_above_overall, AVG(avg_pulse - second_avg) as avg_above_second FROM final_telescopes
